description:
Checks the portfolio drawdown circuit breaker, feature drift guard, 3% turnover
drift buffer, and bid-ask spread gate. Sequences sell reductions before buy
additions with marketable limit collars; never routes trades.

drift_threshold.description: Minimum weight drift fraction required to trigger a rebalance step.
drift_threshold.title: Drift Threshold

equity.description: Current account equity in base currency.
equity.title: Equity

feature_psi.description: Optional Population Stability Index of input features (>0.25 halts risk additions).
feature_psi.title: Feature Psi

limit_collar_bps.description: Marketable limit price collar around midprice in bps.
limit_collar_bps.title: Limit Collar Bps

max_drawdown_limit.description: Maximum drawdown from high-water mark before circuit-breaker liquidation.
max_drawdown_limit.title: Max Drawdown Limit

max_spread_bps.description: Maximum allowed bid-ask spread in bps before rejecting execution.
max_spread_bps.title: Max Spread Bps

quotes.description: Optional quote snapshot {symbol: {bid, ask} or {mid, spread_bps}}.
quotes.title: Quotes

name: warden.plan_rebalance
title: Pre-Trade Rebalance Risk Gate
